{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #FFF7A9 | image = dwts11.jpg | caption = Promotional poster, featuring the celebrity cast | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Brooke Burke]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Jennifer Grey]] | professional_winner = [[Derek Hough]] }} | num_episodes = 20 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{Start date|2010|9|20}} | last_aired = {{End date|2010|11|23}} }} '''Season eleven''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on September 20, 2010, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. Several changes were introduced this season, including an "Acoustic Week," in which couples performed either the [[Rhumba|rumba]] or the [[Argentine tango]] while the audience was brought closer to the dance floor which was elevated and made circular. Contestants from previous seasons also came back as guest judges when the current contestants attempted re-created memorable routines in the 200th episode. These guest judges were [[Hélio Castroneves]], [[Kelly Osbourne]], [[Emmitt Smith]], [[Drew Lachey]], [[Gilles Marini]], and [[Melanie Brown|Mel B]]. [[Kristi Yamaguchi]] and [[Apolo Ohno]] also served as team captains for team dances. There was also a week dubbed "Instant Choreography," in which the couples practiced their routines for a week, but only received the music for their Latin dances 45 minutes before their live performances. Actress [[Jennifer Grey]] and [[Derek Hough]] were crowned the champions, while actor [[Kyle Massey]] and [[Lacey Schwimmer]] finished second, and [[Bristol Palin]] and [[Mark Ballas]] finished third. ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured twelve celebrity contestants. The cast was announced during the August 30 episode of ''[[Bachelor Pad]]'' during a live press conference that included a Q&A session with host [[Tom Bergeron]] and co-host [[Brooke Burke]] and the new cast.
